titulo: The one line every trader looks at 📈
descripcion: A moving average smooths out price noise by averaging the last N prices. Here's what it really shows. Educational content, not financial advice.

escenas.texto: Open any trading chart, and you'll see a smooth line snaking through the price. It's called a moving average.
It's simple. Take the last five closing prices, add them up, and divide by five.
Tomorrow, drop the oldest price and add the newest. The average moves with the market.
Why bother? Prices jump around all day. The average filters out that noise, so you can see the trend.
Many traders watch the fifty day and the two hundred day averages. When the fast one crosses above the slow one, they call it a golden cross.
But remember, it's built from past prices. It shows where the market has been, not where it's going. Follow for more trading basics.
